name: Image Lightbox
description: Site-wide click-to-zoom lightbox for content images: dark overlay, captions from alt text, prev/next navigation with keyboard support and neighbor preloading. Zero-config by default, with a small admin page to toggle it, toggle captions and adjust the content scope selector. WordPress parity: Simple Lightbox / FooBox / Easy FancyBox.
author: WordJS

permissions.reason: Read the lightbox configuration (enabled, captions, content scope selector).
Save the lightbox configuration from the admin page.
Serve the public config endpoint the lightbox script fetches, plus the admin config endpoints.
Add the lightbox settings page to the admin sidebar.
Enqueue the lightbox script and stylesheet on public pages.
